name: Qwen Code

regions.name: terminal
contents: 上からヘッダー、4行の開始ヒント、履歴、入力欄、フッター。サイドバーはこの通常の端末レイアウトにない。 (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/v0.0.1-alpha.14/packages/cli/src/ui/App.tsx)

開始ヒントは「Tips for getting started:」「Ask questions, edit files, or run commands.」「Be specific for the best results.」「QWEN.md」「/help」を含む。 (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/v0.0.1-alpha.14/packages/cli/src/ui/components/Tips.tsx)
入力は丸い枠、左右1文字分の余白、> と Type your message or @path/to/file。送信はEnter。 (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/v0.0.1-alpha.14/packages/cli/src/ui/components/InputPrompt.tsx)
フッターはパス、サンドボックス状態、モデルと残りコンテキストの3領域。 (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/v0.0.1-alpha.14/packages/cli/src/ui/components/Footer.tsx)
contents_en: Header, four startup tips, history, input and footer in a vertical terminal; no sidebar in the ordinary layout. (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/v0.0.1-alpha.14/packages/cli/src/ui/App.tsx)

Tips include “Tips for getting started:”, “Ask questions, edit files, or run commands.”, “Be specific for the best results.”, QWEN.md and /help. (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/v0.0.1-alpha.14/packages/cli/src/ui/components/Tips.tsx)

Rounded input border, one-cell horizontal padding, > and “Type your message or @path/to/file”; Enter submits. (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/v0.0.1-alpha.14/packages/cli/src/ui/components/InputPrompt.tsx)
Footer has path, sandbox status and model with context remaining. (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/v0.0.1-alpha.14/packages/cli/src/ui/components/Footer.tsx)
Main area is 90% of terminal width. (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/v0.0.1-alpha.14/packages/cli/src/ui/App.tsx)

source.notes: Qwen Dark is the initial theme (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/v0.0.1-alpha.14/packages/cli/src/ui/themes/theme-manager.ts); terminal background itself is not forced by this record.

regions.name: terminal
regions.size: 本文は最大100文字列、情報枠は2列時最大60文字列。
contents: 縦方向に会話履歴と入力・フッター。メイン領域は最大100列。通常画面にサイドバーはない。 (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/layouts/DefaultAppLayout.tsx)
ヘッダーの情報枠は単線、横1文字分余白。横幅が許せばロゴ横に最大60列、狭い場合は残り幅を使う。認証、モデル、/model to change、作業パスを表示する。 (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/components/Header.tsx)
Tips: に起動ヒントを1件表示。Type / to see all available commands. はフォールバック。 (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/components/Tips.tsx)

入力プレースホルダーは Type your message or @path/to/file。Enterで送信し、? for shortcuts がフッターにある。 (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/components/Composer.tsx; https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/components/Footer.tsx)
Qwen OAuth、API Keyなどの認証名をモデルとともに表示する。 (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/components/Header.tsx)
入力欄は上下の水平線で、左右の枠はない。 (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/components/BaseTextInput.tsx)
contents_en: Vertical history and composer/footer, with main area capped at 100 columns; no sidebar in the ordinary terminal layout. (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/layouts/DefaultAppLayout.tsx)

Single-border info panel has one-cell horizontal padding, at most 60 columns beside the logo, otherwise fills available width; it shows authentication, model, /model hint and directory. (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/components/Header.tsx)
One startup tip after “Tips:”; “Type / to see all available commands.” is the fallback. (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/components/Tips.tsx)

The placeholder is “Type your message or @path/to/file”; Enter submits and the footer offers “? for shortcuts”. (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/components/Composer.tsx; https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/components/Footer.tsx)
Authentication labels such as Qwen OAuth and API Key appear with the model. (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/components/Header.tsx)
Prompt has horizontal top and bottom lines and no side borders. (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/components/BaseTextInput.tsx)

source.notes: Qwen Dark passes darkSemanticColors, which uses darkTheme rather than qwenDarkColors (https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/themes/qwen-dark.ts; https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/themes/semantic-tokens.ts; https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/cua-driver-rs-v0.27.0/packages/cli/src/ui/themes/theme.ts). Empty foreground inherits terminal color; actual terminal background unverified.

shape.input_shape: Horizontal top and bottom lines without side borders; terminal width.
